bullets.text: Taylor Swift's Instagram Feature - Swifties can remix her Stories with new clips, enhancing fan engagement.
Instagram Map Update - New indicators clarify location sharing, reducing user confusion.
TestFlight's Liquid Glass Support - Apple refreshes TestFlight with a new look and accessibility features.
Deloitte's AI Commitment - Despite a refund for an AI report, Deloitte strengthens ties with **Anthropic**.
OpenAI's Developer Push - New API updates include GPT-5 Pro and enhanced app integrations.
AI Traffic Surge Predicted - Adobe forecasts a 520% increase in AI-assisted online shopping this holiday season.
MrBeast's AI Concerns - Top creator warns AI could threaten livelihoods of content creators.
OpenAI Launches Apps in ChatGPT - New integrations allow users to interact with third-party apps directly.
Lucid Motors' Record Sales - The EV startup sees a surge in deliveries, driven by new models and tax credits.
Meta's New Creator Awards - Instagram introduces a 'Ring' award to celebrate top creators.
